name: FIFA World Cup 2026: Preview Series
overview: FIFA World Cup 2026: Preview Series is a documentary series that looks ahead to the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Each episode highlights national teams, players, and key football stories from around the world. The series explores how countries are preparing for the tournament and the expectations surrounding both favourites and underdog teams.
